title: Dataset datasheet for the simulated truth set (provenance, realism limits)
context: M1 datasheet for the simulated truth set of the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Documents generation method, realism assumptions and limits, and states plainly that simulated performance does not equal clinical performance - a core honesty guardrail of the project. It records provenance and license so downstream users never mistake the simulated set for validated clinical data.
objective: Write the dataset datasheet for the simulated truth set covering generation method, realism assumptions/limits, the explicit 'simulated != clinical performance' statement, sources, and license.
acceptanceCriteria: Datasheet documents generation method, realism assumptions/limits, and an explicit 'simulated != clinical performance' statement.
Sources cited; license stated (CC-BY-4.0/CC0); provenance linked to the sim-101/sim-102 manifests.
output: docs/datasheets/simulated-truthset.md — datasheet for the simulated truth set.
